text: ok so thats 48mb of RAM for bushes then, which mirrors into the gpu just for the sake of edit time? so it would effectively go away in the final product
resolution: Follow-up comprehension question on req_2849: does the 48 MiB CPU foliage buffer vanish in the final product? Answered from source: yes for the elastic PREVIEW buffer (req_2497 live paint preview in world_loader.zig paint slots — regenerated whole while painting, edit-time only). The shipped map carries only a tiny FLORA recipe (per-cell spec/count/chance); at load the same framework/world/foliage.zig generators expand it once into stride-13 instance rows (world_loader.zig ~4650), uploaded to GPU, with streaming gating residency. So a CPU instance array still exists at play, but expanded once at load and sized by the bake, not the continuously-regrowing paint preview. No code changed.
